selection.scope: same already-exposed DEV2; all three seeds per recipe; legacy rates reselected from six frozen fits, no refit

scope: No raw MAT decode, CONFIRM/TEST access or optimizer updates.
Metrics, batch reconstruction, target alignment, eight reference forecasts and 61 rules are independently recomputed.
All 30 fresh fit records and six archived fit records are retained; archived updates are not charged as new training.
Checkpoint replay uses the frozen qualified model implementation, not an independent recurrence.
Saved FIT/DEV filtering provenance is authenticated, not independently re-filtered.
Training gradients/updates and timings are not replayed; traces and Adam ownership are checked.
